subject: Interview day: travel delay — pivot options and reschedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@example.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onsite — Tues Jan 5, 10:00am PST (logistics + agenda)

Hi Alex —

Looking forward to meeting you next Tuesday for the interview loop. Quick logistical notes:

- When: Tue, Jan 5 — 10:00am PST start (please arrive ~10 minutes early)
- Where: Redwood HQ, 3rd floor, Conference B (see attached parking voucher)
- Loop: Hiring manager (Jonas), two senior engineers (Irene + panel), 60–90m total
- Bring: a laptop for the coding exercise; wifi will be provided

I've attached the day agenda and a parking voucher. If anything changes on your side, let me know ASAP and we can adjust.

Safe travels,
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: on-site-agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 28 KB)]
[Attachment: parking-voucher.png (image/png, 12 KB)]

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 07:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite — Tues Jan 5, 10:00am PST (logistics + agenda)

Hi Marissa (and team),

Unfortunately I ran into a transportation issue this morning — my flight into the city was cancelled and the next rental car pickup is delayed due to icy roads. I may still make it to your office but it looks like I’ll be arriving 2–3 hours later than planned. I’m really sorry about the hassle.

Would you be open to either:
- shifting today’s loop to remote (I can hop on video and still do the coding exercise), or
- moving the loop to later that day (after 1pm PST) or another day if that’s easier for you?

I can be flexible if a shortened panel or remote-first approach helps keep everything on schedule.

Thanks for understanding,
Alex
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: candidate travel issue — options?

Jonas/Irene — forwarding Alex’s note. He’s currently delayed ~2–3 hrs and asks to pivot to remote or push to later today.

My availability: I can host a remote slot starting 1:30pm PST if that works. If we can’t do a full loop, proposal: compress to 30–40m (coding + 15m sync with Jonas) remote and then follow up with a short on-site meeting later this week if needed.

Jonas — your calendar looks tight but do you have 1:30–2:30pm open for a compressed remote sync? If not, we can propose Wed/Thu.

—Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: candidate travel issue — options?

Thanks for the heads up. I do have a narrow window at 1:30pm for a 30m sync. Let’s do the compressed remote loop: coding task (30m) then 15m with me and Irene. If Alex can share screen and we have an engineer on the panel, that should be enough to progress.

If Alex prefers full on-site, we can reschedule for Thu (I have a 10–2 block open).

Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@example.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite — pivot to remote at 1:30pm PST today?

Hi Alex — appreciate the quick note and totally understand.

We can pivot to a compressed remote loop starting today at 1:30pm PST. Plan: 30m pairing/coding (screen share) + 15m sync with Jonas/Irene. I’ll send an updated calendar invite with a video link. If you’d rather do a full on-site, we can move to Thu between 10am–2pm — let me know which you prefer.

Also: if you still make it to the office at any point, we’ll honor the parking voucher you received earlier.

Invite to follow in 5.
—Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@example.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up — missed remote slot (1:30pm PST)

Alex — I’m pinging after the 1:30pm remote slot; we didn’t see you join the meeting.

If something came up, no worries — would you be able to share a quick note on what happened so we can reschedule? We have a few options:
- Short remote make-up today between 4–5pm PST
- Thu onsite between 10am–2pm (we can hold 90 minutes)
- Ping with three alternate slots that work for you and we’ll lock one in

If you’re en route still and made it to the office, let us know so we can coordinate an in-person catch-up and cover parking.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up — missed remote slot (1:30pm PST)

Hi Marissa —

I am so sorry — after updating the rental company they pushed my pickup to later this afternoon and my phone battery died while I was trying to coordinate a replacement car; I missed the calendar alert. I feel awful about the no-show.

I’d like to reschedule. I’m available Thu Jan 7 after 11am PST, Fri Jan 8 between 9–12pm PST, or Mon Jan 11 afternoon. If any of those work, I’ll lock it in and I’ll plan to join remotely to be safe.

Thanks for being flexible and again, very sorry for the scramble.
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up — missed remote slot (1:30pm PST)

No worries — thanks for the update and for offering windows. Let’s lock Thu Jan 7 at 11:30am PST as a remote loop (60m). I’ll send an invite and include a short take-home follow-up if we need more time. Parking voucher remains valid if you make it on-site later.

See you Thursday — and safe travels in the meantime.
—Marissa
